module-checks.check-1: rtk npm test -- tests/mygrace-governance-lint.test.ts tests/mygrace-docs.test.ts tests/mygrace-cli-adapter.test.ts

scenarios.scenario-1: A graph-index source path missing MODULE_MAP fails MyGRACE lint.
scenarios.scenario-2: A mismatched START_BLOCK/END_BLOCK name fails MyGRACE lint even when counts match.
scenarios.scenario-3: Managed docs, dashboard, src, and release files pass with complete contract markup.

evidence-types.evidence-1: Deterministic negative fixtures assert missing contracts, maps, change summaries, and block mismatches fail.
evidence-types.evidence-2: Trace assertions identify the exact managed file, missing marker, and index source entry.
evidence-types.evidence-3: Integration checks run `mygrace lint` against the real MAGRA tree.

verification-levels.level-1: Run governance lint unit tests with temporary MyGRACE projects.
verification-levels.level-2: Run existing MyGRACE docs and CLI adapter regression tests.
verification-levels.level-3: Run `rtk mygrace lint --path .`, lint, and typecheck before marking Phase-10 done.

telemetry-requirements.telemetry-1: Lint output reports severity, file, marker name, and source index entry.
telemetry-requirements.telemetry-2: No file contents or secrets are included in lint telemetry.

autonomous-safety.safety-1: Autonomous execution is safe for lint rule additions when negative fixtures fail before implementation and pass after.
autonomous-safety.safety-2: Any new rule that breaks existing valid MyGRACE artifacts without migration plan blocks Phase-10 completion.

evidence.command-1: rtk npm test -- tests/mygrace-governance-lint.test.ts tests/mygrace-docs.test.ts tests/mygrace-cli-adapter.test.ts
